anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex curve composed of approximately 5 low-poly planar facets forming a wide-radius arc from the dorsal ridge to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, conical protrusion with a high thickness-to-length ratio, terminating in a rounded point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse angle of approximately 145 degrees at the intersection of the anterior melon slope and the dorsal rostrum plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Synthetic low-poly geometric mesh structure; uniform cyan-teal emissive surface texture; high-contrast dark circular pixel cluster representing the ocular region.
